question:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/758081f3185c64944dc9b2ca67ba0d0e4342128c5bd7eda872eb9b3db7b9a975.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is as follows:

 
• In 1st step, The arrow moves 2 steps and rotates 45 degrees clockwise,
 
• In 2nd step, The arrow moves 1 step and rotates by 90 degrees clockwise,
 
• Repeat these steps alternatively

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d9543bfffac5543e916a38c511b6f6fa2e41788b66e59ed105b4fa0e8eb61618.png]
